However, the market has responded harshly today with AMD sinking ~8% intraday as Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson specifically highlights investors rotating OUT of AMD/INTC/MU and INTO NVIDIA only. This is a concrete shift in the AI chip narrative — the deal catalyst is being overwhelmed by sector-wide de-rating of non-NVIDIA names. The 10% stop-loss is at risk given ~8% intraday move. Given I just entered this position and the thesis has been materially undermined within hours, it is better to exit cleanly than risk the stop.
